newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Anchorage Telephone.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Anchorage Telephone.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Board of Directors of the Anchorage Telephone Utility (the Board of Directors'') on behalf of the Anchorage Telephone Utility, also known as ATU Telecommunications (the
Preston Gates &Ellis LLP, 701 Fifth Avenue, Suite 5000, Conference Room 8, Seattle, Washington, until 10:00 a.m., Seattle Time, on

for the purchase of the $25,000,000 Telephone Revenue Bonds, Series 1997, at which time bids will be opened and verified. Bids will be announced and considered at the public meeting of the Board of Directors to convene in the Board Room,
Anchorage, Alaska, at 10:30 a.m., Seattle Time, on February 20, 1997.

The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997, and will mature (or be subject to sinking fund redemptions, at the option of bidders) in varying amounts from February 1, 1998 through February 1, 2017. The Bonds will be fully registered under a book-entry system, initially registered in the name of CEDE &Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company. The Bonds are callable on or after February 1, 2007, in whole or in part on any date, at par. The Official Notice of Sale contains the terms of the Bonds and the conditions for bids. The Utility will furnish the approving legal opinion of Preston Gates &Ellis LLP as to the validity and tax-exempt status of the Bonds.

The Preliminary Official Statement and copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale and blank bid forms may be obtained from the Chief Financial Officer, 600 Telephone Avenue, M.S. 58, Anchorage, Alaska 99503 (907) 564-1998 or from the Utility's financial advisor, Patrick Clancy of Clancy, Gardiner &Pierce, LLC, 115 N.W. First Avenue, Suite 401, Portland, OR 97209 (503) 221-1126.
